name: Buying And Selling Dogs
overview: Scripture addresses the concept of 'dogs' in a symbolic and moral context, warning against bringing the price of a dog into the house of the Lord as it is considered an abomination (Deuteronomy 23:18). The term 'dogs' is associated with those outside the covenant community who reject God's holiness, as seen in Matthew 7:6 and Revelation 22:15, where dogs represent those who are unworthy of sacred things and live in sin. This teaches believers to discern carefully whom they entrust with what is holy and to trust wholly in the Lord rather than their own understanding (Proverbs 3:5).
